detail.longDescription: Most of my lost afternoons started with opening an app to check one small thing. Treating attention as a budget you decide where to spend, instead of a leak you patch later, changed how my days feel. The full thinking is at https:// vibrationofawesome.com/blog/bo om/posts/attention-as-a-resource-you-can-allocate-on-purpose # attention # productivity # creatortools You are probably carrying more than you realize.
